title: Zero-dimensional coherent sheaves are cohomologically trivial: a coherent sheaf on a locally Noetherian scheme whose support has dimension at most 0 is generated by global sections and has vanishing higher cohomology.

core_obligations: Restrict F to its scheme-theoretic support.
Decompose the 0-dimensional Noetherian support into affine pieces.
Conclude global generation for G and push it forward.
Compare cohomology along the affine closed immersion.

proof_roadmap.step: Restrict F to its scheme-theoretic support.
Decompose the 0-dimensional Noetherian support into affine pieces.
Conclude global generation for G and push it forward.
Compare cohomology along the affine closed immersion.

difficulty_reason: Each step is written in the span: factor F as i_*G for G coherent on the scheme-theoretic support Z (lemma-coherent-support-closed on the same shelf); a locally Noetherian scheme of dimension 0 is a disjoint union of affines (properties-lemma-locally-Noetherian-dimension-0), so G is globally generated with zero higher cohomology (affine vanishing); the pushforward of a globally generated sheaf by any morphism is globally generated; and cohomology agrees along i since a closed immersion is affine (lemma-relative-affine-cohomology), transporting the vanishing from G to F.

dedup.scope: Cohomological triviality of 0-dimensional coherent sheaves, used in the Noetherian induction base cases.
